START.description: Initial state. Session created. Entry context received.
START.transition_logic: If service_hint resolves to canonical service → SERVICE_SELECTION. Else → METIER_SELECTION.

METIER_SELECTION.description: Resolving which métier (plomberie, électricité, etc.) applies.
METIER_SELECTION.transition_logic: When metier is resolved from priority chain → SERVICE_SELECTION.

SERVICE_SELECTION.description: Client or system selects specific canonical service within métier.
SERVICE_SELECTION.transition_logic: When service_code resolves to a canonical registry entry → QUALIFICATION.

QUALIFICATION.description: Evaluating eligibility conditions and hard exclusions against known inputs.
transition_logic: If any pending safety questions → QUESTION_REQUIRED (priority=SAFETY)
If any routing boundary questions pending → QUESTION_REQUIRED (priority=ROUTING)
If all required inputs satisfied and no exclusion → READY_FOR_ENGINE
If hard exclusion: routing type → ROUTE_REQUIRED
If hard exclusion: safety type → SAFETY_STOP
If hard exclusion: requalify type → REQUALIFY

QUESTION_REQUIRED.description: Orchestrator needs one more input from client.

READY_FOR_ENGINE.description: All required inputs collected. Payload validated. Ready to call engine.

ENGINE_EVALUATION.transition_logic: Engine result commercial_output_type determines target state.

PRICE_READY.description: Engine returned FIXEO_PRICE or FIXEO_CALCULATED_PRICE. Price is exact and contractual.

DIAGNOSTIC_READY.description: Engine returned FIXEO_DIAGNOSTIC. Show diagnostic price + absorption conditions.

LABOUR_PLUS_PART_READY.description: Engine returned FIXEO_LABOUR_PRICE_PLUS_PART. Labour price known; parts separate.

ADD_ON_READY.description: Engine returned FIXEO_ADD_ON. Only valid in context of a primary service.

QUOTE_REQUIRED.description: Service requires bespoke quotation. No price shown. Valid successful outcome.

ROUTE_REQUIRED.description: Client need belongs to a different métier or specialist. Redirect.

SAFETY_STOP.description: Safety exclusion triggered. No price. Client must receive safety instruction.

REQUALIFY.description: Scope exceeds standardized service. Redirect to quote or adjacent service.

CONFIRMATION_READY.description: Full outcome ready. Client can proceed to next action.

transition_principle: Every state change is deterministic. No implicit state. All transitions documented.
